test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

If she be found guilty of any misconduct during her tenure, (1)/ the disciplinary committee reserves the right (2)/ to withhold her pending dues (3)/ or initiate further legal action. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the subjunctive mood "**be**" in a real conditional clause.
 
• The sentence describes a possible future condition (Type 1 Conditional). In such cases, the simple present tense should be used instead of the base form of the verb.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**If she is found guilty**," as "is" is the appropriate third-person singular present form of the verb "to be."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**If she is found guilty** of any misconduct during her tenure, the disciplinary committee reserves the right to withhold her pending dues or initiate further legal action."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "the disciplinary committee reserves the right" **– This part correctly uses the singular verb "reserves" to agree with the collective noun "committee."
 
• **3: "to withhold her pending dues"** – This part is grammatically sound, using the infinitive "to withhold" correctly.
 
• **4: "or initiate further legal action."** – This part maintains parallel structure with the previous infinitive phrase.
